investigation: Why does training-free ref-KV injection transfer identity on Z-Image (strip) but not Lumina-2.0?

instrumentation.measure: exact softmax mass target-image-query -> injected ref-key columns, per layer
instrumentation.ref_bias: uniform additive pre-softmax logit on all ref columns (all heads) = causal routing knob

item1_ref_attention_quant.note: same subject u2 (pink hair), same strip (pre-RoPE, position-free) mechanism
item1_ref_attention_quant.key_norm_ref_vs_ctx: matched in BOTH models (Z ~20 vs ~20; Lumina ~16 vs ~16)
item1_ref_attention_quant.verdict: PRIOR HYPOTHESIS FALSIFIED: Lumina does NOT ignore strip keys (attends 4-9%, comparable to Z's 7%). Both models attend ~2x more to position-bound keys.

excluded_candidates.1_qk_norm_scale: key norms ref==ctx in both models -> not norm starvation
excluded_candidates.2_softmax_scale: Lumina scale LARGER (sharper softmax) -> cannot explain low ref-mass; and mass is not low
excluded_candidates.4_attention_routing_amount: comparable mass Z vs Lumina; forcing mass up does not help (see item3)

item2_determinant.surviving_determinant: content-addressing SELECTIVITY/EFFICIENCY of a POSITION-FREE (phase-stripped) key. Z-Image's per-query ref-attention is PEAKED (content-selective); Lumina's is DIFFUSE (spreads over all ref tokens = averages to color-bleed, not structured identity).

selectivity_measurement.metric: per-query attention over ONLY ref columns, renormalized; normalized entropy [0,1] (0=peaked/selective, 1=uniform/diffuse) + mean top-1 peak prob
selectivity_measurement.reading: Z is 2.4x more PEAKED (peak 0.102 vs 0.043) and lower entropy (0.70 vs 0.81) -> Z content-addresses structured identity; Lumina reads a diffuse average -> explains why forcing Lumina's mass gives unstructured pink color-bleed, not the ref's structured features.

item2_determinant.candidate_cause: RoPE theta (Z=256 vs Lumina=10000). Low theta rotates even low-freq channels fast -> a phase-stripped key spreads across relative positions & queries can select it distinctively (peaked content dictionary); high theta barely rotates low-freq channels over the image -> a phase-stripped key looks near-identical (relative-pos~0) to all queries -> diffuse. NOT isolated experimentally (theta baked into a trained model; cannot cleanly swap). CORRELATIONAL on the salient arch difference; the selectivity dissociation is the mechanistic bridge.
item2_determinant.corroboration: Lumina rope (position-bound, refsize==size) DOES bring identity through as a noisy position-locked paste -> proves V carries identity; only the position-free content-addressing route is inefficient/diffuse.

item3_causal_test.note: CORRECTED after advisor flagged a value-magnitude confound in the first (w=2, band8-15) sweep: at w>=2 the injected w*ref-value blows Lumina's cond_norm/noise_norm renorm -> blank-white wash (a magnitude artifact, NOT a routing outcome). Rerun at low w and MATCHED deep band 16-23.

first_sweep_CONFOUNDED.outcome: blank->noise wash (value-magnitude artifact, discard as routing evidence)

item3_causal_test.outcome_CORRECTED: Forcing mass up raises hair PINKNESS monotonically (18->37), BUT visual audit of rb3/rb4 (pre-collapse) shows this is MEAN-COLOR BLEED, NOT structured identity: the face stays the MODEL'S OWN, eyes stay dark-grey (NOT ref's PURPLE), NO red pendant -- only a diffuse pink tint on hair-tips/collar. Pinkness PLATEAUS at ~37 = ref's MEAN hue (39.5), never Z's structured 65. At matched mass 0.07 Lumina shows 0 structured id while Z shows FULL structured id (hair+purple eyes+pendant).
item3_causal_test.verdict: Structured identity NEVER transfers in Lumina at any coherent operating point. Forcing the (diffuse) position-free attention only injects the ref's MEAN COLOR. -> verdict (1) clean-rescue is DEAD.

overall_verdict.mechanism_clean: descriptive dissociation clean; CAUSE not isolated
overall_verdict.clean_part: (1) Falsified the prior 'Lumina softmax ignores strip keys' hypothesis: both attend 4-9%. (2) Ruled out key-norm mismatch and softmax-scale (Lumina's is sharper). (3) STRONGEST result (unconfounded): at MATCHED mass 0.07, Z transfers FULL STRUCTURED identity (hair+purple eyes+red pendant) while Lumina transfers NONE -> the discriminator is content-addressing SELECTIVITY (Z per-query ref-attention 2.4x more PEAKED: entropy 0.70 vs 0.81, peak 0.102 vs 0.043). (4) Lumina rope (pos-bound) copy-pastes -> V carries identity; only the position-free content route is diffuse.
overall_verdict.murky_part: No clean rescue: forcing Lumina's diffuse routing yields MEAN-COLOR bleed, never structured identity, at any coherent operating point. AND the CAUSE of the selectivity gap is NOT isolated -- N=2, so RoPE theta (256 vs 10000) is CONFOUNDED with GQA (30kv vs 8kv, candidate 4, untested), depth (30 vs 26 layers), Gemma2 text encoder, and training data. 'It's theta' is a hypothesis, not earned.
overall_verdict.aaai_implication: Verdict leans (2) but a CHARACTERIZED (2): clean descriptive dissociation + failed causal rescue + UNISOLATED cause. A 'universal training-free activation recipe / rescue-Lumina' method paper is DEAD. A comparative-MECHANISM paper is defensible ONLY IF it claims the SELECTIVITY DISSOCIATION as the discriminator (not theta as cause, not 'we transfer identity to Lumina'). To upgrade toward a strong causal mechanism paper: isolate the cause WITHIN one model (apply a high-theta rotation to Z's injected strip key via refpos surgery; if Z's transfer collapses to color-bleed, phase-geometry is causally implicated with no N-confound) OR add a 3rd model on a theta gradient (Krea-dev). Without that, converge.

item4_theta_causal_isolation_Zonly.goal: Single-model (Z-Image ONLY) isolation of RoPE phase geometry as the determinant, removing the N=2 confound (GQA/depth/text-encoder/data). Rotate Z's injected ref key with an actual RoPE at a SWEEPABLE theta (refpos='thetasweep' added to 30_kv_inject.py, default off; same center-aligned ref grid at every theta so THETA is the only variable). Theta grid 256(Z native)->1000->4000->10000(Lumina's baked theta). Band 16-25, w4, u2, seed0, 30 steps -- Z's established identity-transfer operating point.
item4_theta_causal_isolation_Zonly.prediction_if_theta_is_cause: theta up -> per-query ref-attn peak DOWN, normalized entropy UP (toward Lumina's diffuse anchor peak0.043/ent0.806) AND structured identity (pink hair+purple eyes+red pendant) degrades to mean-color bleed = reproduces Lumina failure inside one frozen model.

identity_verdict_per_theta.theta256: STRUCTURED identity (pink hair + purple eyes + red teardrop pendant) present; compositional framing/polaroid artifact from native-theta center positioning
identity_verdict_per_theta.theta1000: STRUCTURED identity present (hair+purple eyes+red pendant), clean composition
identity_verdict_per_theta.theta10000: STRUCTURED identity STILL FULLY present (pink hair + purple/violet eyes + red teardrop pendant on gold necklace) -- NOT color-bleed

item4_theta_causal_isolation_Zonly.reading: Dose-response is monotonic in the predicted direction (peak 0.151->0.109, entropy 0.618->0.680) but SATURATES by theta=1000 and, decisively, its ENDPOINT LANDS IN Z'S WORKING REGIME, NOT Lumina's failing one: at Lumina's theta=10000 peak~0.109 == Z's OWN strip anchor (0.102) and entropy 0.680 is BELOW the strip anchor (0.703) -- i.e. still MORE peaked than plain strip, and nowhere near Lumina's diffuse anchor (peak0.043/ent0.806). Structured identity (pink hair+purple eyes+red pendant) survives at EVERY theta including 10000. ROOT CAUSE OF THE BUILT-IN NULL (verified numerically): RoPE freq_i=1/theta^(2i/d), so RAISING the KEY's theta REDUCES its rotation (frac of near-frozen channels rises 0.21->0.54 over 256->10000, mean |angle| 6.44->4.18 rad) -> a higher-theta key converges TOWARD the position-free STRIP key, which is Z's WORKING representation. The sweep therefore interpolates center@256(super-peaked) -> strip-like@10000(working), staying inside Z's working range the whole way; it CANNOT reach Lumina's diffuse failure by construction.
item4_theta_causal_isolation_Zonly.verdict: (2) DESCRIPTIVE -- but for an HONEST reason, NOT 'theta falsified'. This key-side test is INCONCLUSIVE about theta: (i) it manipulates the KEY's theta while queries stay at Z's native 256, whereas the phase-geometry hypothesis is about QUERY-side theta (Z queries@256 vs Lumina queries@10000 reading a position-free key); (ii) the key-side knob moves the key TOWARD Z's own strip/working regime (see reading), so a null is built-in and carries no information about the query-side mechanism. The direct query-side test is INFEASIBLE within one frozen model: changing tf.rope_embedder.theta rotates ALL queries+keys off-distribution -> breaks generation -> confounds 'identity lost' with 'model broke'. NET: the single-model theta isolation the plan proposed does NOT support a strong-causal theta claim, and cannot refute one either -> the CAUSE of the selectivity/identity dissociation REMAINS UNRESOLVED. Strong-causal AAAI upgrade via within-Z theta isolation is NOT achievable this way.
item4_theta_causal_isolation_Zonly.decision_for_aaai: Do NOT upgrade to strong-causal. Ship the CHARACTERIZED descriptive dissociation (clean cross-model selectivity gap + failed Lumina rescue + UNISOLATED, likely-unisolatable-within-one-model cause). A comparative-mechanism paper claiming the SELECTIVITY DISSOCIATION as the discriminator remains defensible; a 'phase geometry is THE cause' claim is NOT earned. The 3rd-model-on-a-theta-gradient route reintroduces N-confounds.
